policy: No external source code/prose copied. Core algorithms use NumPy/local code only; sklearn is a dev-test reference.
reference_alignment: Actual bootstrap cohorts, objective normalization, full sampling, explicit CV folds, tree depths and class-column order aligned. No full XGBoost/CatBoost library parity claim.
catboost_reference: Independent ordered-statistic, prefix-exclusion, constant-prefix and symmetric-tree enumeration oracles; production CatBoost Algorithm 2 is a different implementation, so exact output equality is not asserted.
